driver.hash_semantics: final driver bytes before the Coordinator snapshot; a future lock must bind these actual bytes, the actual execution-plan hash, and a later clean executing commit

tests.scope: fixed static/synthetic/mock regression only; no frozen fixture selection/search, collision census, experimental control/timing panel, Cayley calibration, trust root, signature, real lock, or real RUN directory

future_machine_protection.preservation: fsync staging progress after each fixture acceptance/rejection, completed start/certificate, completed cell, and each Cayley guard-boundary progress record

future_cost_accounting.policy: DEC-20260907-38017a makes historical wall/CPU estimates advisory. They are measured, not future stop/invalidation gates. The process-group memory guard, cancellation checks, and one-worker bound still apply.

future_algorithm.fixture_selection: first 32 p at b=9,11 and B=0..31, lexicographically; record singular/supersingular/subgroup rejections; select first two eligible distinct p per b or declare incomplete without widening
future_algorithm.subgroup_enumeration: enumerate O,G,...,(r-1)G through one checked repeated-addition accumulator; retain starts-at-O, distinctness, r-times-G, method, and count certificate before canonical sorting
future_algorithm.seed_streams: execute and retain 606300..606307 as labeled exploratory cells, then 606308..606315 as labeled held-out cells; exploratory data cannot alter a fixture, u, assignment, metric, threshold, or decision; only the 96 held-out cells enter global_decision
future_algorithm.availability: pooled-side: Zcoord>0 and sum(Znull_j)>0; retain all seven null arms and their work even where an individual Znull_j=0
future_algorithm.certificates: zero denominator is fruitless; nonzero denominator with verification failure is a failed certificate and immediately stops after durable cell/certificate custody with completed_invalid
controls: executed all-start constant-O reset census with zero nonzero denominators and zero solves
separate 128-bit reversible Cayley row/column/eigen/TV calibration with guarded stride-16 loops
future_algorithm.decision: one global all-u positive/negative/inconclusive decision after the held-out 96 cells; unavailable valid cells are retained and make that decision inconclusive

future_artifacts.publication: same-filesystem sibling staging, per-file fsync/hash verification, complete-set verification, pre-rename fsync, rename, explicit post-rename durability state, and quarantine with typed receipt under runs/incomplete on failure

required_review_bindings: reviewed and executing source bytes match the lock hashes

remaining_gate: Coordinator snapshots these six exact TASK-20260908-6a010d artifacts under TASK-20260908-8e93d0 and arranges a fresh independent source-bound review before any measurement admission.
